credit: Elfet original PR622 and prior discovery of undocumented431; renhi Codex-assisted independent exact-threshold/duplicate/byte-count and declaration controls.
finding_scope: Independent confirmation and strengthening of an already reported documentation gap; not a new server vulnerability or31 independent bugs.
byte_count_rule: sum(len(raw_name)+len(raw_value)+4) per ASGI header tuple; duplicates count separately
limitations: Unchanged selected HeaderLimits/text/constant bodies execute in a minimal real Starlette/Uvicorn/h11 loopback fixture; full Linux-dependent app is not imported.
Candidate manifest literal caps bind its app's original manifest.MAX_* expressions via a constant-only namespace; not a full manifest module replacement or server run.
No ref-token accounting, filesystem, auth, rate limiting, production reverse proxy/CDN, hostile TLS or alternative HTTP parser tested.
Candidate declaration suffix and _plain helper executed only on captured live JSON copies; full candidate openapi_document generation and endpoint are not executed.
POST is only a local oversized-header case blocked before the minimal fixture handler; no public-service test writes or oversized probes.
Thirty-one missing declarations are manifestations of one shared document gap; local boundary results confirm existing behavior, not a behavior change.
No full Linux repository tests, upstream CI, original branch modification, new PR/comment or author adoption; the existing PR still needs reviewer gates.
No user key or wallet used for tests. Protected existing key is used separately only for the explicitly authorized factual DID summary.
No official role, airdrop qualification or testnet compute settlement established.
